reference_sql:
WITH ranked AS (  -- one row per order of a known customer
  SELECT customer_id, order_ts,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_ts DESC, order_id) AS rn
  FROM orders
  WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT date_trunc('month', order_ts) AS last_order_month, COUNT(*) AS customers
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', order_ts)
alternatives:
WITH latest AS (  -- one row per known customer
  SELECT customer_id, MAX(order_ts) AS order_ts
  FROM orders
  WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT date_trunc('month', order_ts) AS last_order_month, COUNT(*) AS customers
FROM latest
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', order_ts)

SELECT date_trunc('month', t.order_ts) AS last_order_month, COUNT(*) AS customers
FROM (
  -- one row per order of a known customer, numbered from the latest
  SELECT customer_id, order_ts,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_ts DESC, order_id) AS rn
  FROM orders
  WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
) AS t
WHERE t.rn = 1
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', t.order_ts)

other_way.sql:
WITH latest AS (  -- one row per known customer
  SELECT customer_id, MAX(order_ts) AS order_ts
  FROM orders
  WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT date_trunc('month', order_ts) AS last_order_month, COUNT(*) AS customers
FROM latest
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', order_ts)
other_way.tradeoff: Only the latest time matters, so MAX(order_ts) per customer works with no window, but it cannot return the order's other columns.

solver.query:
WITH r AS (SELECT customer_id, order_ts, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_ts DESC, order_id) AS rn FROM orders WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL)
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', order_ts) AS DATE) AS last_order_month, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM r WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY 1
